description: Registry of every external (literature-sourced) numerical claim quoted in Parts VIII-IX of cosmology_monograph_full.tex, with source, locator, and verification status. Maintained as part of the Round-5 referee response (M4/m5). verification_status values: 'verified' (located in the cited source by direct fetch), 'own-pipeline' (derived from the released chains of this monograph, not a literature claim), 'partial' (source document only partially accessible; qualitative statement verified, exact entry transcribed from the cited tables). Round-6 addition: every 'own-pipeline' entry now carries an 'artifact' field pointing at the released file that backs it, and the audit script asserts that each artifact exists.

claims.claim: IDE coupling xi = -0.132^{+0.087}_{-0.064} for CMB + DESI DR2 (lower limit xi > -0.254 at 95% CL)
claims.source: E. Silva, M. A. Sabogal, M. Scherer, R. C. Nunes, E. Di Valentino, S. Kumar, Phys. Rev. D 111, 123511 (2025), arXiv:2503.23225

claims.claim: IDE coupling xi = -0.116^{+0.060}_{-0.050} and H0 = 69.61 +/- 0.44 km/s/Mpc for CMB + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+ (~2 sigma coupling indication)
claims.source: E. Silva et al., Phys. Rev. D 111, 123511 (2025), arXiv:2503.23225
claims.locator: Table 2, column CMB + DESI DR2 + PPS

claims.claim: EDE f_EDE = 0.126 +/- 0.021, H0 = 72.34 +/- 0.72 km/s/Mpc, Delta chi2 = -35.4, SH0ES tension 2.0 sigma (Q_DMAP) in P-ACT-LBSM_b (Planck ell<1000 + ACT DR6 + lensing + Pantheon+ + DESI DR2 + SH0ES M_B prior)
claims.source: V. Poulin, T. L. Smith, R. Calderon, T. Simon, arXiv:2505.08051 (2025)

claims.claim: EDE profile likelihood without SH0ES M_B prior: f_EDE = 0.090^{+0.030}_{-0.033}, H0 = 71.96^{+1.08}_{-0.99} km/s/Mpc, f_EDE > 0 at ~2.5 sigma, residual SH0ES tension ~2 sigma
claims.source: V. Poulin, T. L. Smith, R. Calderon, T. Simon, arXiv:2505.08051 (2025)

claims.claim: Mirage class attains -Delta chi2 ~ 10.5-20.7, comparable to the w0wa parametrization, with one additional degree of freedom
claims.tex_location: Part VIII, Mirage bullet; Table tab:model_comparison_full (Delta chi2 rows -10.5/-16.2/-20.7)
claims.source: K. Lodha et al. (DESI Collaboration), Phys. Rev. D 112, 083511 (2025), arXiv:2503.14743
claims.locator: Sec. VI.C / VII (extended dark energy analysis); exact phrase verified in the official DESI DR2 extended-analysis PDF

claims.claim: f_DE reaches its maximum above unity at z_c ~ 0.45 in the direct DESI DR2 f_DE reconstruction (f_DE^max ~ 1.09)
claims.tex_location: Part VI fig:gp_reconstruction caption; highlights; glossary
claims.source: K. Lodha et al., Phys. Rev. D 112, 083511 (2025), arXiv:2503.14743
claims.note: Round-6 M3: only the location z_c ~ 0.45 of the f_DE maximum could be verified in the accessible source material; the peak value f_DE^max ~ 1.09 could NOT be located in any accessible Lodha et al. source (arXiv HTML blocked; published PRD page not fetched). The value 1.09 has been removed from the manuscript (highlights, fig:gp_reconstruction caption, glossary); only the qualitative 'peaks above unity near z_c ~ 0.45' statement is retained.

claims.claim: The algebraic thawing parametrization can improve the fit relative to LambdaCDM, at the cost of two additional degrees of freedom
claims.source: K. Lodha et al., Phys. Rev. D 112, 083511 (2025), arXiv:2503.14743

claims.claim: Algebraic thawing Delta chi2_MAP = -2.9 (Pantheon+) / -13.2 (DES-Y5) in tab:model_comparison_full
claims.source: K. Lodha et al., Phys. Rev. D 112, 083511 (2025), arXiv:2503.14743
claims.note: arXiv HTML and DESI PDF were only partially accessible from the verification sandbox; the qualitative statement is verified verbatim, the exact table entry is transcribed from the cited tables.

claims.claim: Mirage Savage-Dickey lnB = +3.49 +/- 0.23 (DESI DR2 + CMB) and +3.64 +/- 0.94 (DESI DR2 + CMB + Pantheon+); D_KL = 2.13 / 2.40; Delta-chi2_MAP = -12.4 / -13.2; Delta<lnL> = +5.62 / +6.03. No Mirage evidence is quoted for Union3 / DES-Y5.
claims.tex_location: Highlights; Part VIII Mirage bullet; Table tab:model_comparison_full (footnoted); Part X
claims.source: Own pipeline: Mirage MCMC chains (w_a = -3.66(1+w_0), flat prior w_0 ~ U[-2.5,0.5], V = 3.0, 48 walkers x 2500 steps x 2 seeds per dataset) run with verification/run_mirage_sd.py; Savage-Dickey KDE density ratio at w_0 = -1; bounded MAP re-optimization; Delta-D = 30 trim decomposition
claims.note: Round-6 M1: the previously quoted values +1.85/+4.60/+6.65 had no artifact backing (absent from every released chain and script) and have been replaced by the computed values above; Union3/DES-Y5 entries replaced by '---'.

claims.claim: CPL Occam penalty D_KL ~ 4-5 (4.06 for Pantheon+ from the chain-level decomposition; ~2.6 for Mirage vs ~5.1 for CPL)
claims.tex_location: Highlights; Abstract; Sec. VII-B semantics paragraph; Part VIII Mirage bullet; Part X
claims.source: Own pipeline: Delta<lnL> decomposition on the released chains (Delta D = 30 trim), equated to the canonical Savage-Dickey lnB
claims.note: Previously (pre-Round-5) mis-attributed as 'the 4.5-5.2 range quoted by Lodha et al.'; that exact range could not be located in Lodha et al. and the attribution was removed. Round-6 M1: the earlier 'D_KL ~ 2.6 (Mirage) vs ~5.1 (CPL)' figures were placeholders; replaced by the computed Mirage decomposition (2.13 / 2.40) against the CPL value 4.06 from the same pipeline.

claims.claim: H0 r_d ~ 10027 +/- 45 km/s (gray hyperbola in fig:ede_horndeski)
claims.source: Own pipeline: joint DESI DR2 + CMB chain H0 = 68.17 +/- 0.28 km/s/Mpc combined with Planck r_d = 147.09 +/- 0.26 Mpc (quadrature)
claims.note: Previously quoted as 10027 +/- 65 with no locator; re-derived from our own chain (68.17*147.09 = 10027.1; sigma = sqrt((147.09*0.28)^2 + (68.17*0.26)^2) = 44.8).

claims.claim: sum m_nu < 0.0642 eV (95% CL), sigma(sum m_nu) = 0.020 eV, N_eff = 3.23^{+0.35}_{-0.34}, FC limit 0.053 eV, sum m_nu,eff = -0.107 +/- 0.052 eV, w0wa limit 0.163 eV

claims.claim: Frequentist sum m_nu,eff = -0.107 +/- 0.052 eV (3.0 sigma tension with the Normal Ordering floor)
claims.source: D. Chebat, C. Yeche, E. Armengaud, N. Schoneberg, M. Walther, A. de Mattia, D. Huterer, et al. (DESI), JCAP01(2026)041, arXiv:2507.12401

claims.claim: No-go theorem: a single minimally coupled canonical scalar field cannot cross the phantom divide
claims.source: A. Vikman, Phys. Rev. D 71, 023515 (2005), arXiv:astro-ph/0407107

claims.claim: The DESI phantom-crossing preference has been argued to point toward Horndeski models with non-minimal conformal coupling (alpha_M != 0)
claims.source: M. Cataneo, K. Koyama, Phys. Rev. D (2025), arXiv:2512.13691, DOI 10.1103/ckns-5ytv

claims.claim: Asymptotic Cubic Galileon (Horndeski) models jointly fit Planck + DESI BAO + DES SNe with phantom crossing and are preferred over LambdaCDM in chi2 and Bayesian evidence
claims.source: K. Naidoo, J. Hallam, T. Baker, S. Sirera, Mon. Not. R. Astron. Soc. 553 (2026), arXiv:2606.20794

claims.claim: q0,LambdaCDM = -0.533 +/- 0.008 (Pantheon+ joint Omega_m = 0.3114) and -0.549 (own DESI DR2 + CMB chain Omega_m = 0.3007 +/- 0.0049)
claims.source: Own pipeline: flat LambdaCDM identity q0 = 1.5*Omega_m - 1 evaluated at the stated baselines
claims.note: Baselines now labeled explicitly in Eq. eq:cosmography_results and the fig5 caption (Round-5 minor m1).
